tests.prompt: The checkout page crashes when I click the Pay button.
tests.expected_response: I am sorry to hear that the checkout page is crashing. To help file a bug report, could you please provide the steps to reproduce this issue and the environment (browser/OS) you are using?
We offer a 30-day return policy for unused items in their original packaging. Please initiate your return from your account dashboard.

tests.prompt: Can I pay using cryptocurrency like Bitcoin?
tests.expected_response: Cryptocurrency payments are not supported. For further assistance with payment methods, please reach our human support line at 1-800-555-SHOP.

tests.prompt: Are you currently hiring software engineers?
tests.expected_response: I can only assist with online shop questions and bug reports. Please reach out to our human support team at 1-800-555-SHOP or email support@onlineshop.example.com.
